column1: # Polish (pl) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context    usually empty. `preview` words sample text inside rendered previews.
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: translated from the plain meaning of the English labels in ordinary computing
# vocabulary. No Microsoft Word or other product localisation, string table, or translated UI
# was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay in Latin letters.
# Counts use count-neutral wording (`Słów: 21` / `Liczba stron: 1`), avoiding plural-form issues.
